entities.summary: Kenia Guadalupe Flores Osuna, known professionally as Kenia Os, is a Mexican social media personality. She rose to "fame" as a content creator on YouTube, joining a larger team of creators where she amassed millions of subscribers, before continuing on her own. She signed with Lizos Music in 2018, releasing her debut single "Por Siempre". After a period as an independent artist, she signed with Sony Music Mexico and released her debut studio album, Cambios de Luna (2022), followed by the successful albums K23 (2023), Pink Aura (2024) and  K de Karma (2026).
